rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for putting separate things together as one.

example.english: We unify the two tables so it is easier to eat.
example.traditional: 我哋將兩張枱合埋，食飯方便啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 loeng5 zoeng1 toi4 hap6 maai4 sik6 faan6 fong1 bin6 di1

rows.note: Use this when formally merging organisations, companies, regions, or other established units.

example.english: The board decided to unify the two companies.
example.traditional: 董事會決定將兩間公司合併。
example.jyutping: dung2 si6 wui6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 hap6 bing3

rows.note: Use this when making different systems, standards, or practices the same and unified.

example.english: The school will unify the exam formats for all subjects.
example.traditional: 學校將各科考試格式統一。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 zoeng1 gok3 fo1 haau2 si3 gaak3 sik1 tung2 jat1
